what: tapered extrude of a D shape (an arc meeting a line at a sharp corner): refused as 'tapered profiles where an arc meets another edge at a corner'
method: half disc r5 (x>=0) with a -10 deg taper (shrinks inward), 2 mm: the section at height z is the eroded D = disc r=5-d cut at x>=d, d=z tan10deg (erosion of a convex intersection is the intersection of the erosions). Area(d) = rho^2 acos(d/rho) - d sqrt(rho^2-d^2), rho=5-d; V = integral_0^2 Area(z tan10) dz = 69.7714 (Simpson; Area(0) = 12.5 pi = 39.27 at the base)
